builders.angle: LITERAL -- work BRIEF-r43's fix list 1 to 4 in order and exactly as written, one wing at a time, the Crypt FIRST (the round's fight). Never fewer objects; keep every change inside your four wings.

THE OBJECT DRAWN -- each wing's weak subject is a primitive: the Hedge's noise box, the Attic's soft trunk, the Crypt's cardboard half-domes, the Bathhouse's cloned tub. Draw each as a real object with an inked, broken silhouette, mass and a contact shadow first, then light the near floor round it.

LIGHT THE FLOOR, THEN FILL IT -- the near floor falls to black or milk in all four wings. Give each a lit near floor from a source the room has (a lantern, moon shafts, candles in the crypt), then stand that wing's own objects in the light, richer than before -- never fewer.
